title: Estimate, then measure
description: Estimate a length, weight, or count, then measure it and say how far you were.
oneStarDescription: Write an estimate of a length, a weight, or a count before you measure.
twoStarDescription: Measure with a tool and write the difference from the estimate.
threeStarDescription: Estimate a second, similar thing and say what you changed because of the first difference.

title: Explain a rule of a game
description: Explain one rule of a game so a new player can apply it on the next turn.
oneStarDescription: Explain one rule without reading, using the pieces or cards.
twoStarDescription: Play one example of the rule and one example of a break.
threeStarDescription: Let the new player use the rule, and correct only if they break it.

title: Fill in a form completely
description: Complete a form and check it before you send it.
oneStarDescription: Fill each required field, and mark a field you do not understand instead of inventing an answer.
twoStarDescription: Where the form asks for a fact you can check, copy it from the document rather than from memory.
threeStarDescription: Read the form once more, correct one error, and only then send or say you are ready.

title: Film a short stable clip
description: Film a short clip with a start and an end, held steady enough to watch.
oneStarDescription: Film a few seconds of one subject without walking, and watch it back.
twoStarDescription: Film a clip that begins before the action and ends after it.
threeStarDescription: Shoot again if the first is unwatchable, keep the better take, and say why.

title: Find a rough direction from the sun
description: Use the sun and the time of day to name a rough direction, and say when you would not trust it.
oneStarDescription: In daylight, point to the sun and say which horizon it is toward.
twoStarDescription: Using the time of day, name one rough cardinal direction and how you got it.
threeStarDescription: Say one condition, such as heavy cloud or being unsure of the time, when you would use a map or ask instead.

title: Fold a paper box
description: Fold a box from paper that closes and holds a small object.
oneStarDescription: Fold a sheet on a pattern you can show, with creases that meet.
twoStarDescription: Assemble it so a lid or flap closes.
threeStarDescription: Put a small object inside, close it, and reinforce or refold the corner that fails.

title: Follow a shot list
description: Write the shots you need and collect them, including one you had to change.
oneStarDescription: Write three shots, each with a subject.
twoStarDescription: Take each shot and tick it only if the subject is the one you wrote.
threeStarDescription: If one shot is impossible, write a replacement that still serves the same purpose.

title: Give credit for an idea
description: When you use someone's idea, say whose it was.
oneStarDescription: In a note or a meeting, attribute one idea to the person who offered it.
twoStarDescription: Say what you added, so the original idea stays visible.
threeStarDescription: If you forgot someone, correct the record where the first version went.

title: Glue a clean joint
description: Glue two pieces so the joint holds after it has set, using a glue meant for those materials.
oneStarDescription: Fit the pieces without glue and mark their position.
twoStarDescription: Apply glue as its label says, align the marks, and hold or clamp until the label's set starts.
threeStarDescription: After the label's wait, test the joint with a gentle load and say whether it held.

title: Hand-wash a delicate garment
description: Wash one delicate garment by hand and dry it in the way the label allows.
oneStarDescription: Wash a garment in water with a product meant for hand washing, then rinse until the water runs clear.
twoStarDescription: Press or roll the water out and show that you did not twist the cloth out of shape.
threeStarDescription: Point to a symbol that would stop you hand-washing a different garment, such as dry clean only.

title: Hang a light frame
description: Hang a light frame so it is level and the hook is in a place that can hold it.
oneStarDescription: Mark where the hook must go so the frame will sit at the height you want.
twoStarDescription: Fix a hook suited to a light frame, hang the frame, and show it is level.
threeStarDescription: Point to a heavier object you would not hang this way, and say what you would need to know first.

title: Harvest an herb without killing it
description: Take a small harvest from a living herb and leave enough growth for the plant to continue.
oneStarDescription: Cut or pinch a small amount from the tips, not the whole plant.
twoStarDescription: Show the leaves or shoots you left, and say why they are enough.
threeStarDescription: Use the cut herb the same day or say how you dried a piece, and note the plant's response if you look again.

title: Hold a plank with form
description: Hold a plank position and come down when the form goes, not when a clock says so.
oneStarDescription: Set a plank on hands or forearms and show a line from head to heels that a helper can see.
twoStarDescription: Hold only while the line stays, then come down and say what started to sag.
threeStarDescription: Repeat from the knees or from the toes, choosing the version where you can keep the line, and say why.

title: Host a simple meal
description: Host a simple meal where a guest knows when to arrive and what they are eating.
oneStarDescription: Invite a guest with a time and one sentence about the food.
twoStarDescription: Have the meal ready enough to sit down with the guest, and offer water.
threeStarDescription: Ask about a food limit before you cook, and change or label one dish because of the answer.

title: Inflate a tire to the marked pressure
description: Inflate a bicycle tire to a pressure written on the tire, and check it.
oneStarDescription: Read the pressure range printed on the tire, including the unit.
twoStarDescription: Add air and check with a gauge, stopping inside the printed range.
threeStarDescription: If you removed nothing, spin the wheel and say whether it rubs. If it rubs, stop and say you would ask before forcing it.

title: Introduce two people
description: Introduce two people by name and by one true reason they might talk.
oneStarDescription: Say both names and check that you pronounced them as they wish.
twoStarDescription: Add one true, non-private reason each person is there or what they might talk about.
threeStarDescription: Leave the two of them talking, or close the introduction if one person wants to stop.

title: Introduce yourself in a minute
description: Introduce yourself for a specific room, with your name and why you are there.
oneStarDescription: Say your name and why you are in the room, in a few sentences.
twoStarDescription: Take out a detail that does not matter for this room, and say it again.
threeStarDescription: End with one way the listener can respond, such as a question they could ask.

title: Iron a shirt smooth
description: Iron a shirt so the collar, front, and a sleeve are smooth.
oneStarDescription: Iron one part of a shirt until the wrinkles you started with are gone.
twoStarDescription: Iron the collar, the front, and a sleeve, and hang the shirt so new creases do not form.
threeStarDescription: Set the iron from the care label and point to a fabric you would not iron at that setting.

title: Juggle three balls
description: Juggle three balls in a cascade and pick up after a drop.
oneStarDescription: Throw one ball from hand to hand so it peaks at a height you can catch.
twoStarDescription: Start a cascade and complete several catches, or stop and say which throw collapsed.
threeStarDescription: After a drop, restart from the same start position without changing the pattern in a panic, and say what you reset.

title: Keep a decision log
description: Record a decision, the reason, and the result you will look at later.
oneStarDescription: Write the decision, the date, and the reason in one place.
twoStarDescription: Write what you will look at later to see whether it worked.
threeStarDescription: When the time comes, write what happened and whether you would decide the same way.

title: Keep a list of important documents
description: List important personal documents and where they are, without copying their secret numbers into the list.
oneStarDescription: List the documents you would need to find in a hurry, such as identification or a lease.
twoStarDescription: Write where each one is kept, without writing the full secret number.
threeStarDescription: Ask someone else to find one item from your list, or do it yourself after a day, and fix a place that was wrong.

title: Keep a steady beat
description: Keep a pulse with your hands while a song or a metronome continues.
oneStarDescription: Clap with a metronome or a recording and stay with it for a short passage.
twoStarDescription: Keep clapping when the click stops for a few beats, then show whether you met it when it returns.
threeStarDescription: Keep the pulse while someone sings or a melody plays, and stop if you drift, then say where.

title: Keep a travel log
description: Keep a short log of where you went, what it cost, and one thing you would change.
oneStarDescription: Write the place, the main way you traveled, and one cost.
twoStarDescription: Add a second day and the total of the costs you wrote.
threeStarDescription: Write one thing you would do differently on a similar day.

title: Keep a score others can check
description: Keep a score that another player can reconstruct from your marks.
oneStarDescription: Record one score change so a player can see who gained it.
twoStarDescription: Update the total after each change and show the arithmetic once.
threeStarDescription: When someone doubts a total, show the marks that add up to it, or correct it.

title: Lead a group clap
description: Start a clap and bring a small group in with you.
oneStarDescription: Clap a tempo and count the group in.
twoStarDescription: Keep the clap going while the group joins, and nod or speak if they rush.
threeStarDescription: Give a clear ending and stop with the group, then say whether they finished together.

title: Learn a short tune by ear
description: Learn a short tune by listening, without requiring an instrument.
oneStarDescription: Listen to a short tune and sing or hum its shape back.
twoStarDescription: Mark the phrase you lose, listen only to that phrase, and sing it again.
threeStarDescription: Sing or play the tune from the start without the recording, and name the phrase you still need.

title: Learn the names of people you meet
description: Learn and use the names of people you just met.
oneStarDescription: Repeat a person's name when they say it, and ask if you said it right.
twoStarDescription: Use the name once later in the conversation, naturally.
threeStarDescription: If you forget, ask again, use the name, and write a respectful note to yourself if you need one.

title: Leave a clear voicemail
description: Leave a voicemail that says who you are, why you called, and how to reply.
oneStarDescription: Record a message that starts with your name and one reason for the call.
twoStarDescription: Leave a callback number or another reply path, spoken slowly enough to write down.
threeStarDescription: If the system lets you, listen back and rerecord if your name or number was unclear.

title: Let everyone speak once
description: In a small group, make sure each person speaks once before anyone speaks twice on the decision.
oneStarDescription: Ask each person for one comment before you give your own view.
twoStarDescription: When someone starts a second turn, ask for a person who has not spoken.
threeStarDescription: Say the range of views you heard, including one you do not share.

title: Letter a short word by hand
description: Letter a word so the letters share a height and the word can be read.
oneStarDescription: Write a word in capitals or a consistent script, slowly enough to control the shapes.
twoStarDescription: Draw a guide and remake the word so the letters sit between the lines.
threeStarDescription: Adjust one awkward gap and show the word to someone who can read it at a glance.

title: Load a dishwasher so water can reach
description: Load dishes so the spray is not blocked and a glass is not resting on its side.
oneStarDescription: Load a rack so items face the spray and do not nest inside each other.
twoStarDescription: Place a plastic or light item where the maker says it may go, or leave it out and say why.
threeStarDescription: After a cycle, point to one item that came out dirty and say what blocked it.

title: Look up a word and use it
description: Look up an unfamiliar word and use it in a sentence that shows the meaning.
oneStarDescription: Look up a word in a dictionary you can name, and copy the meaning you will use.
twoStarDescription: Write a sentence of your own that would fail if the word meant something else.
threeStarDescription: If the dictionary gives another meaning, say why you did not use that one.

title: Make a bed so it stays neat
description: Make a bed with the sheet smooth and the covers tucked so they stay when you sit.
oneStarDescription: Fit the sheet and smooth the wrinkles you can see.
twoStarDescription: Tuck the covers so they stay when you sit on the edge and stand up.
threeStarDescription: Replace the used linen with clean linen and say where the used linen goes next.

title: Make a collage with a point
description: Arrange found images so a viewer can say what point the collage makes.
oneStarDescription: Write the point in one sentence before you stick anything down.
twoStarDescription: Arrange at least three pieces so they support that sentence, and fix them.
threeStarDescription: Ask someone what they think the point is, and change or remove one piece if they cannot tell.

title: Make a quiet-hours agreement
description: Agree quiet hours with someone you live with, in words you can both check.
oneStarDescription: Propose a start and an end, and the rooms they cover.
twoStarDescription: Change one part because of what the other person needs, and restate the whole agreement.
threeStarDescription: On a day it applies, follow it or say you broke it, and agree how you will handle the next time.

title: Make a simple notebook
description: Bind a few sheets into a cover so the pages turn and stay in.
oneStarDescription: Fold sheets into a section and nest them.
twoStarDescription: Fasten the section into a cover so pages do not fall out when you shake it gently.
threeStarDescription: Write a line on the first and last page and show that the fastening still holds.

title: Make a small textile square
description: Knit or crochet a small square with an even edge, using one method.
oneStarDescription: Cast on or chain, and make one row of stitches you can count.
twoStarDescription: Add rows until you have a square, and count the stitches at the end against the start.
threeStarDescription: Bind or fasten off, and show an edge that does not unravel when you tug gently.

title: Make notes you can study from
description: Make notes from a source that you can use later without the source in front of you.
oneStarDescription: From a short text or talk you may use, write the points in your own words.
twoStarDescription: Mark one place where your note is incomplete, and fill it from the source.
threeStarDescription: Put the source away, answer a question from the notes, and check one claim you were unsure of.

title: Make soup from what you have
description: Make a vegetable soup from ingredients already in the kitchen and say what gives it body.
oneStarDescription: Cook vegetables in liquid until they are tender enough to eat as soup.
twoStarDescription: Taste and change the salt, the body, or the liquid, then say which change you made.
threeStarDescription: Serve a bowl and name one ingredient you left out because it would not have helped.

title: Match a pitch
description: Sing or hum a note you just heard, and notice when you are flat or sharp.
oneStarDescription: Hear a note and sing or hum it back so a tuner or another person says it matches.
twoStarDescription: If you miss, say whether you were low or high, using a tuner or a listener, and try once more.
threeStarDescription: Match three notes in a row and mark the one that was least sure.
